role: Prospective complete-learning development, not confirmation or manuscript evidence
baseline_selection: Per task strongest development mean native-transition return AUC among all seven non-recycle controls; preserve every method, seed and task
metrics: Native-transition return AUC primary; logical total communication return AUC over common observed range, final return, source/proposal/score/potential costs and CPU supplemental
resource_scope: Equal 16000 native training joint transitions per method. No already-paid work refunded. Logical trajectory, incoming-gradient and outgoing-policy bytes charged. Queues price prospective outbound broadcasts and extra scoring forwards; source backprop, Adam proposals, potential fit and evaluation all reported separately. Delays model transport, not physical GPU speedup.
stop: Payload failure stops the run without retry; complete scientific failure stops this frozen design, then mechanism diagnosis, not gates/seed/task changes. No GPU or manuscript admission from development alone.
